routeSelectionBasis: The route election is the form itself: CrRLJ 09.0800 (rev. 07/2022, sha256 260367f6930cacc89727fc8a48aa0591b07ad5c7183b6412aa247b1810503d7b) is the dedicated single-ground petition for misdemeanor cannabis conviction vacation and prints its statutory basis (RCW 9.96.060) on its face. Read first-hand for FIX10: the form face carries no ground checkbox and no blank naming an RCW ground, so there is no election on the form for the packet to mark; choosing CrRLJ 09.0800 over CrRLJ 09.0100 is the route-determined election, per CrRLJ 09.0300 section 2.a.
note: Integration-ready repair payload only. This record grants no runtime, commercial, fulfillment, eligibility, branch-selection, or approval authority.

instrumentKinds: Washington Cannabis Vacation Application under RCW 9.96.060(5)
binding.whyPaymentIsClosed: Commercial authority comes from a Grade-A fulfillment record keyed to an exact route and packet family, and from nothing else. This binding is not that record, and nothing in this repository has produced one.
